### [`fill_row11_char_9e`](../../../../src/landscape/row11_fill.asm#L6) `$4E50`

*routine*

Fills the screen row 11 ($05b8-$05df) with character $9e in colour $0f. Row 11 is the first row below the raster split at line $8a.
